title: Catriona Gray to grace 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show as special guest
summary: Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray is set to take her iconic walk to another global stage as she attends the 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show as a special guest on October 19 (Philippine time).
